title: GLM-4 9B Chat joins the text models
summary:
A text-model reshuffle: GLM-4 9B Chat was added, three OpenAI listings moved to GPT-4.1 Nano, and reasoning-model availability changed.

Added GLM-4 9B Chat through Intelligence.io with an 8,192-token model configuration.

The openai, openai-fast, and openai-roblox listings now route to Azure GPT-4.1 Nano. That replaces GPT-4o Mini for openai, while openai-roblox moves from the nectar tier to anonymous access.

Removed openai-reasoning (O3) from the available model list and set DeepSeek R1 0528’s maximum output to 2,000 tokens.

highlights.title: GLM-4 9B Chat added
highlights.text: GLM-4 9B Chat is available as a text model with an 8,192-token configuration. [Browse models](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models).

highlights.title: GPT-4.1 Nano routes
highlights.text: `openai`, `openai-fast`, and `openai-roblox` now route to Azure GPT-4.1 Nano. `openai-roblox` also allows anonymous access. [Browse models](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models).
